thresholds.calibration: maximum absolute individual round/pair effect across every scene
thresholds.primary_relation: lower95 strictly greater than global floor

bootstrap.unit: whole comparison round, all scenes and contrasts together

method.calibration: Three independent B-only rounds, labels B/S/V retained to test all three pairs; not comparison baselines.
method.comparison: Six rounds use BSV,SVB,VBS,BVS,SBV,VSB, each palindrome p+reverse(p), with rotating scene order.
method.summary: Two log CPU observations per arm within a complete scene/round; average six round contrasts before transforming.
method.clock: CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID around the complete control-frame + MIDI + render step in 512 callbacks; sum raw ns, no subtraction.
method.order: Normal unchanged control frame applied BEFORE each block's new pressure/bend/CC74; then Engine.render.
method.moving_events: At block b divisible by4: member=(b//4)%8+2, x=float((b*13)%97)/96.f, pressure=x, bend=x*.1f, CC74=x at offset0.
method.startup: One fresh process per slot, 8 Note Ons before warm block0, no release within the window.
method.no_adaptation: No discarded valid observation, window slide, extra calibration, resumption, replacement, rerun or endpoint/arm substitution.
method.precision: Six clusters only. Nominal intervals and palindrome balancing do not remove nonstationary/workload-correlated VM bias.
method.scope: Offline whole-core proxy, not a VST3/plugin callback, DAW meter, native result or realtime-capacity guarantee.
method.scalar_choice: The scalar-only fallback was a pre-cost choice if V was absent. This completed run chose three arms, so S is not a replacement primary.

fixture_note: Embedded sources are data for hash/audit completeness; replay.py never compiles or runs them. Engine source is identified separately.
rtf_note: Geometric means of complete comparison rounds only, denominator 32768 external audio frames / 48000 Hz; absolute engineering target0.15 is not a relative gain threshold.
